main_text.p: Accedunt horum aliæ etiam passim causæ internæ: utpote, 1. pravi habitus acquisiti; si homines sint edocti male facere, &c. Jerem. 13. 23.
2. Ignorantia facti, vel etiam juris: 1 Tim 1. 13. 1 Cor. 2. 8. Act. 3. 17. Psal. 147. 20. cum Act. 14. 16.
4. Vacuitas reverentiæ Dei; Gen. 20. 11. Psal. IV, 20. 21.
5. Mentis cæcitas, & cordis duritiæ: Eph. IV, 17, 18.
8. Subjectio ad serviendum peccato: Rom. 6. 16. 1 Reg. 21, 25.
9. Alia peccata, propter cognationem, affinitatem, vel dispositionem: 1 Tim. 6. 10. 1 Joh. 2. 16. Ezech. 16. 49.
Atque item externæ: 1. Diabolus, tenator & seductor: Joh. 8. 44. Matt. 4. 3. 2 Cor. 2. 11. XI, 3. 1 Petr. 5. 8. Eph. 6. 11, 12. Apoc. 2. 24.

2. Mundus corruptus: 1 Job. 5. 19. Quò pertinent hominum mundanorum consilia prava, doctrinæ falsæ ac fallaces, invitationes, & persuasiones malæ, tentationes tum ad dextram, tum ad sinistram: Prov. 1. 10, 15. Matth. 7. 15, 16. Apoc. 2. 14. 1 Cor. 15. 33. Dan. 3. 6. Act. 26. 11.
3. Res prosperæ, quibus plurimi per abusum luxuriant: Ezech. 16, 49. Psal. 62. 11. Rom. 2. 4. Prov. 30. 8, 9.
4. Ex accidenti etiam ipsa Lex Divina: Rom. 7. 9, 10, 11.
main_text.head: XXXIX. Peccata ifto dispescuntur multifariam.
main_text.p: Ratione materiæ, aliud est peccatum per se; aliud per accidens. Peccatum per se dicitur, ubi ipsa talis actio objective prohibita est Lege Divina: ut idololatria, furtum, mendacium, &c. Per
